ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of UBOs and directors against UIAF PEP database, OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions, and Colombian national criminal/AML records, applied before incorporation and updated periodically under risk-based supervision.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) – www.rues.org.co
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Business names must be in Spanish or in Latin-script transliteration; names must be distinguishable from existing registered names; foreign words are permitted only when not misleading and when accompanied by Spanish descriptors if required by the registry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may file a written reconsideration with the corresponding Chamber of Commerce within 10 business days, citing no confusion or availability under RUES; if still denied, a formal appeal can be submitted to the Superintendencia de Sociedades within one (1) month from the reconsideration decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office acceptance is permitted for low-risk digital publishing companies provided a physical registered address is designated for official legal notifications; the address must be a place where documents are actually received, either physically or through an authorized courier, and must be maintained during the corporate existence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: estimated 5% annual likelihood for low-risk, non-licensed digital media businesses, subject to sector-specific risk profiling and administrative discretion.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Régimen de las Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas), arts. 1-45; Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), arts. 98, 110, 354; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015, arts. 2.2.1.1.1-2.2.1.1.5 (RUES registration procedures).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (CCB) – Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument containing the estatutos), filed through RUES; optional Escritura Pública if the incorporators elect notarial form.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for an S.A.S.; the founders freely determine the subscribed and paid capital in the bylaws. At least one share must be subscribed and paid at incorporation; the unpaid balance of subscribed capital may be distributed over a maximum term of two (2) years, which must be expressly stated in the bylaws. Capital contributions must be deposited in a Colombian bank account opened in the company's name before the Registry issues the final certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION No. 001: The subscribing shareholders unanimously resolve: (1) To approve the full subscription of the issued share capital and the capitalization table; (2) To adopt the registered office at Bogotá D.C., as recorded in the commercial registry; (3) To appoint [Legal Representative] as the Company's legal representative and principal signing officer; (4) To appoint [Revisor Fiscal] as statutory auditor where legally required; (5) To ratify the founders' preliminary acts and authorize the legal representative to complete DIAN tax registration, RUES filing, and bank account opening; (6) To receive and acknowledge payment of the subscribed capital. This resolution is approved unanimously and takes immediate effect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-validación de nombre (Name Availability and Homonimia Check)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (CCB) – RUES online portal (www.rues.org.co) or any CCB service window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a name reservation application on the RUES portal or at a CCB service point, providing three proposed corporate names in descending order of preference. The system searches existing commercial registries and issues a Certificado de Homonimia confirming that the selected name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing company. The approved name reservation remains valid for thirty (30) calendar days.
required_dossiers: Solicitud de nombre (Formulario de homonimia) with three proposed names
Cédula de ciudadanía or passport of each incorporating shareholder
Contact and notification email/address of the authorized applicant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the selected name is rejected due to homonymy, file a corrective substitution request with new alternative names; the substitute filing is processed free of charge within the same calendar day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Otorgamiento de los Estatutos (Execution and Signature of the S.A.S. Bylaws)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública (optional notarial form) or the incorporators directly by private document (Documento Privado) authenticated before the CCB
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft a comprehensive S.A.S. instrument containing the company name, domicile, corporate object (digital magazine publishing and sponsored media placements), authorized capital, term, governance rules, representation clauses, and dispute-resolution mechanism. All incorporators must sign the private document either physically in Colombia or before a notary abroad with the apostille and consular legalization, or through a lawful attorney-in-fact. The document must be paginated and each page initialed by all parties.
required_dossiers: Draft bylaws (documento privado de constitución)
Valid identification documents (cédula/passport) of all shareholder signatories
Approved Certificado de Homonimia for the chosen name
Special power of attorney (poder especial) if representation is used
Apostilled and translated foreign incorporation documents (if any foreign shareholder executes abroad)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry or Notary detects substantive omissions, the incorporators must execute an aclaración or reforma estatutaria correcting the defect; rejected private documents are refiled within the RUES query period at no additional registry charge.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscripción en el Registro Mercantil (Commercial Registration with the Chamber of Commerce)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – Registro Mercantil (RUES integrated filing window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed bylaws along with the single registration form (Formulario de Registro Único Empresarial), payment of the matrícula mercantil fee, and the annexed tax registration forms to the CCB through the virtual ventanilla or physical desk. The CCB examines the instrument for compliance with Law 1258/2008 and issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal upon successful inscription.
required_dossiers: Signed private incorporation instrument or notarial deed (original and copy)
Formulario de Registro Único Empresarial (RUES form)
Formulario única de registro con otras entidades (DIAN, Fondo de Garantías)
Proof of payment of the registration fee and matrícula mercantil tariff
Certificate of homonimia previously approved
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Deficiencies identified by the CCB are notified through a requerimiento; the incorporators have ten (10) business days to correct and resubmit. An appeal (recurso de reposición) lies against a definitive denial before the same registry authority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registro Tributario ante la DIAN (Tax Identification and RUT Registration)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – official virtual offices and authorized service points
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The legal representative must file the RUT pre-registration through the DIAN virtual portal, obtain the assigned NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria), and activate the electronic signature. The company's tax obligations (income tax, VAT, withholdings) depend on the declared economic activity ISIC 5813. If foreign shareholders participate, the corresponding Declaración de Inversión Internacional must be registered with the Banco de la República within the statutory deadline.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal issued by the CCB
Notarized copy of the estatutos sociales
RUT preliminary form and DIAN Form 001/490
Cédula/passport of the legal representative
Proof of paid-in capital deposit in a Colombian bank account
Formulario de registro de inversión extranjera (Banco de la República) when applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DIAN database shows inconsistencies between RUES data and the RUT, the legal representative must file a corrección de RUT through the transactional portal; mismatched addresses or legal representation are reconciled within five (5) business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Apertura de Libros de Comercio y Certificación Final (Opening of Corporate Books and Final Certificate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (registration of books) and Notaría Pública (protocolization when required)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The legal representative must register the corporate and accounting books (libro de actas, registro de accionistas, libro diario y mayor, libro de inventarios) at the CCB, either physically or through the RUES digital book certification module. After the books are sealed and foliated, the company obtains the definitive certified copies of its corporate existence and the legal representative's standing to transact.
required_dossiers: Corporate and accounting ledgers (libros) physically bound or in the approved electronic format
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Minutes appointing the legal representative (Acta No. 001)
Payment receipt for the book registration tariff
Solicitud formal de registro de libros ante la CCB
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the CCB rejects the books for technical non-compliance, the petitioner corrects the pagination or foliation defects and presents the books for a second review free of additional registry tariff; a fresh certificate is issued upon successful validation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Tecnologías de la Información y las Comunicaciones (MinTIC) – Dirección de Contenidos y Medios; Comisión de Regulación de Comunicaciones (CRC) for content-provider registration
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro de Proveedor de Contenidos y Medios Digitales (Registro de Medios de Prensa Digital) – Inscripción y Constancia de Operación ante MinTIC/CRC

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente de Bogotá (SDA); Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) only if infrastructure development is involved
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categoría 4 – Actividad de bajo impacto ambiental (digital publishing is a white-list service activity); no full EIA report is required. Only a basic environmental registration (Diligencia de Registro de Generadores de Residuos Peligrosos) applies if the office generates special wastes.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero industrial liquid discharge; office operations limited to domestic wastewater complying with Resolución 0631 de 2015. VOCs and cleaning-agent emissions must satisfy the air-quality thresholds of Resolución 2254 de 2017. Hazardous and electronic waste (RAEE) must be channeled through authorized reverse-logistics schemes under Resolución 1512 de 2010 (computers and peripherals) and Resolución 1326 de 2017 (lamps).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Bomberos (Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos de Bogotá) approving fire-prevention measures and evacuation routes; structural load inspection and occupancy license (Cédula de Uso y Aforo) from the Alcaldía Mayor de Bogotá for the physical office; mandatory ARL (Administradora de Riesgos Laborales) registration and workplace safety plan documented through the Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - Colombia's national tax and customs administration. Official taxpayer portal: www.dian.gov.co; transactional e-services via MUISCA (muisca.dian.gov.co) and the VUCE foreign-trade single window. DIAN exclusively administers NIT allocation, RUT registration, electronic invoicing clearance, VAT refunds and customs export declarations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: incorporate the S.A.S. by private deed registered with the Cámara de Comercio, which automatically transmits incorporation data to DIAN. Step 2: within 10 business days, the legal representative or, for non-resident owners, an appointed local agent (apoderado) must complete the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) pre-registration through MUISCA and certify it with a digital certificate in order to obtain the definitive NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). Step 3: the RUT profile is set to ordinary VAT responsible ('régimen común', code 15), income-tax assessor and CIIU 5813 activity classification; no separate VAT identification number exists. Step 4: the NIT/RUT must be updated for any change in address, activity, or statutory representative within 10 business days, and must be attached to the exporter profile to activate export VAT credit refund rights.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (central monetary and foreign-exchange authority; issuer of binding exchange regulations via Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83 and related DCIN Series). The Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia supervises and licenses the intermediarios del mercado cambiario (IMCs) that execute all regulated FX flows, while the DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) enforces customs- and tax-linked aspects. Principal legal instruments: Law 9 of 1991 (Estatuto Cambiario), Decree 1735 of 1993, Decree 2080 of 2000, and the Central Bank regulations applicable to IMCs, as amended.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia applies a managed free-market convertibility model. The Colombian peso (COP) is convertible for current-account operations (export proceeds, royalties, service fees, profit and dividend remittances) provided the funds are channeled through an authorized IMC and evidenced by the corresponding exchange declaration (declaración de cambio). Capital-account flows (equity injections, equity sale proceeds and capital reductions) are liberalized but strictly registration-dependent: a foreign investment in the SAS must be recorded in the Registro de Inversión Internacional maintained by Banco de la República, filed through the IMC via Formulario No. 4, before the investor can lawfully remit dividends, liquidation proceeds or sale consideration out of Colombia. Profit remittance for a non-resident shareholder requires (i) a verified inbound investment registration, (ii) an approved corporate distribution resolution, (iii) settlement of the statutory dividend withholding applicable to non-resident beneficiaries, and (iv) an exchange declaration evidencing the remittance concept. In practical terms, the regime is convertible-with-traceability: every inbound and outbound cross-border wire must map to a declared concept code, making clean telegraphic-transfer narratives and pre-registered investment or compensation references operationally critical for digital-publishing cash flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For a Colombian SAS exporting digital-magazine and sponsored-media services to non-residents, 100% of the export invoice value must enter the regulated channeling route: proceeds must be collected from the foreign payer and channeled through an IMC or into a previously registered cuenta de compensación abroad (with corresponding periodic reporting) within the statutory term, generally six (6) months from the invoice date or from completion of the performance for services, extendable only through regulated causes (e.g., DIAN-authorized customs deferrals or approved force-majeure filings). There is no mandatory surrender ratio converting proceeds into COP: the exporter may retain FX in a domestic foreign-currency current account, in a registered offshore compensation account, or sell it to the IMC at a freely negotiated rate benchmarked against the TRM (Tasa Representativa del Mercado) published by Banco de la República. Each sale, channeling or compensation-account movement must be recorded under Formulario No. 2 (services and other concepts) in the collection period. Failure to channel within the term, or channeling without a matching exchange declaration, exposes the exporter to Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia FX fines and risks DIAN recharacterization of the income as unreported domestic-source revenue.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (designated USD/COP deposit account for the registered foreign-investment inflow) + Operational Current Account (COP)
Capital Escrow Account + Operational Current Account (COP/USD) with integrated FX-investment registration desk
Operational Current Account (COP) + foreign-currency deposit account
Operational Current Account (COP/USD) with derivatives-eligible corporate treasury line
Operational Current Account (COP) + global SWIFT treasury infrastructure
Corporate Current Account + trade finance / commercial letter of credit desk

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Foreign Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs such as Wise, Revolut Business, Airwallex, Payoneer, Currenxie) are legally constrained in Colombia: they hold no Colombian banking license, cannot engage in deposit-taking (captación de recursos del público is reserved to licensed credit institutions under Law 35 of 1993), and cannot execute exchange declarations before Banco de la República, issue COP-denominated tax-compliant receipts, or settle Colombian supplier payroll and VAT obligations. Their viable role for this SAS is strictly an offshore collection overlay: aggregating Stripe and AdSense USD/EUR payouts and optimizing conversion before a SWIFT MT103 remittance into the licensed IMC account in Colombia. Feasibility rating: Medium as a treasury-optimization overlay; Low as a substitute for the primary local current account or for the foreign-investment channeling requirement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance of the legal representative, and of each individual holding signatory power, at a local branch or corporate-desk interview is the default and, in practice, mandatory expectation of Tier-1 Colombian IMCs for a newly incorporated SAS with non-resident shareholders. Remote opening is not a statutory entitlement; it is available only under discrete corporate digital programs combining prior relationship, video-identity verification and apostilled powers of attorney. Prudent planning: schedule a face-to-face compliance interview in Bogotá or Medellín for the legal representative; where a foreign shareholder acts as legal representative, execute a notarized and apostilled power of attorney appointing a Colombian resident officer, complemented by a live video-KYC session, so that the bank can verify the beneficial-owner structure under the SAGRILAFT framework (Circular Básica Jurídica 029 of 2014, as amended).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity: a multi-jurisdictional shareholder chain without a cleanly mapped Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) for UIAF purposes.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (1) Apostilled certificate of incorporation and current existence (certificado de cámara de comercio) of the SAS; (2) full ownership-chain diagram from the SAS up to each individual UBO; (3) notarized UBO declaration in the UIAF-compliant format; (4) passports of UBOs and signatories; (5) bank reference letters from the foreign remitting bank; (6) sworn undertaking to inform the bank of any ownership change within the statutory term.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume unknown-counterparty digital revenue received from global ad-tech platforms (Stripe, AdSense, programmatic DSPs) without auditable commercial documentation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (1) 12-month platform settlement statements; (2) executed network agreements (Stripe Connected Account and AdSense contracts) with platform identifiers; (3) monthly traffic and subscription analytics extracts; (4) sample invoices rendered to advertisers; (5) hosting and content-platform licensing receipts evidencing digital-operational substance; (6) RUT excerpt and foreign-service export identification filed with DIAN.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injection originating from a shareholder jurisdiction classified as high-risk or tax-preferential by the bank's risk matrix.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (1) Sworn and apostilled affidavit of source of funds signed by the shareholder; (2) audited financial statements or certified net-worth evidence of the investor; (3) corporate registry extracts and business-purpose filings of the shareholder; (4) negative sanctions-screening results for all shareholders, signatories and counterparties; (5) explanation memo linking the investment to the SAS's business plan and target payment rails.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between wire purpose codes, exchange declarations and the foreign-investment registration, e.g., mixed subscription revenues and equity injections in one SWIFT string.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (1) Pre-filed or same-day Registro de Inversión Internacional (Formulario No. 4) issued by the IMC; (2) wire test key and MT103 narrative referencing the investment registration number; (3) board resolution of the SAS identifying the capital contribution; (4) internal ledger mapping each inflow to the regulated concept codes (2 = services and transfers; 4 = international investment; 6 = compensation account operations); (5) auditor's letter confirming classification of equity versus trade receipts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil – annual renewal of commercial registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (Registro Único Empresarial y Social – RUES)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: March 31 each year, regardless of incorporation date; renewal tariff is a variable official fee assessed on net assets (minimum approx. USD 7).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: If not renewed by 31 March, a late-renewal penalty is imposed by the Chamber plus interest; registrations may be suspended after six months and cancelled after prolonged non-renewal, with loss of the company's standing to undertake commercial acts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements approved by shareholders and deposited with the commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholder approval by 31 March following the 31 December fiscal year-end; deposit with the Chamber immediately after approval and no later than the annual renewal filing.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deposit financial statements prevents renewal of the matrícula mercantil; administrators may be held jointly liable for damages and the Chamber may impose fines under commercial registry regulations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Form 210 – annual income tax and complementary return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between early April and late June of the following year for the December 31 tax period, staggered by the last two digits of the NIT pursuant to the applicable DIAN Resolution.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Extemporaneous filing penalty of 1.5% per month or fraction of the tax due, capped at 100% of the tax; failure to file triggers minimum sanction on gross revenues or net equity, plus interest and coercive collection; no administrative strike-off applies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual exogenous information report (Información Exógena) – third-party and beneficiary payment data
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due annually in accordance with a DIAN Resolution, generally between February and May of the year following the tax year, with dates staggered by NIT digit.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to the higher of 1% of gross income or net equity and a minimum of 10 UVT per omitted or inaccurate data item; correction reductions may apply if filed voluntarily.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: For a S.A.S., a revisor fiscal (statutory auditor) is mandatory where (i) the company's bylaws so require; (ii) total gross assets at fiscal year-end exceed 5,000 times the statutory monthly minimum wage (approx. USD 1.6 million in 2024); (iii) gross income in the preceding year exceeds 3,000 times the statutory monthly minimum wage (approx. USD 1.0 million); or (iv) the company is subject to supervision by the Superintendencia de Sociedades or another authority requiring statutory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: NIIF para Pymes (IFRS for SMEs) under Colombian law for Grupo 2 companies; full IFRS (NIIF completas) for Grupo 1 entities; micro-enterprise standards (NIF) for Grupo 3. For a low-asset S.A.S., the relevant framework is IFRS for SMEs unless the company voluntarily adopts full IFRS or is classified as a large taxpayer.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: At each annual renewal of the matrícula mercantil (due 31 March), the S.A.S. must confirm and update its final beneficiary (beneficiario final) declaration in RUES. Any share transfer or equity change must be reported to RUES within 15 working days of the registration of the transfer in the shareholders' register; ownership thresholds of 5% or more trigger UBO identification. Failure to file or update the UBO declaration is subject to fines of up to 10 monthly minimum wages per event by the Superintendencia de Sociedades.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 180 – 400 per year for registered-office/agent services in Bogotá or Medellín
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 – 5,000 per year if a revisor fiscal or certified audit is compulsory

stage_6.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (Law 2277 of 2022, Article 240 E.T.; applicable to all resident commercial companies including S.A.S.)
stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday; conditional 'Orange Economy/Naranja' income tax exemption (Law 1955/2019, Article 176; up to 7 years at 0% for newly constituted creative/digital companies meeting job creation and territorial conditions, subject to DIAN registration and annual compliance). Additional deductions: 30% of investments in science, technology and innovation (CTeI); 100% deduction of special payments to 'Sociedades BIC'? (no); standard VAT input credits for export/digital services can lower overall VAT burden, not CIT. For qualifying digital publishing with CTeI accreditation.
